title: ND Combined Drought Index: scripts for an experimental Landsat-based Combined Drought Index for North Dakota, 2000-2023
description: Google Earth Engine and Python scripts for the corrected Combined Drought Index (CDI) for North Dakota, the derivation of its normalization limits and principal-component weights, the benchmark against the U.S. Drought Monitor, NOAA nClimDiv PDSI and SPI-3 and detrended crop yields, the county benchmark, the variance decomposition, and the figures of the accompanying article.
notes: Supported by the U.S. Geological Survey under Grant/Cooperative Agreement No. G23AP00683 (AmericaView).
